answer: A shared ridge registry records every bond and delivery. A new identity must lock a 45,000 POA onyx bond in escrow that unlocks only after ten dispute-free verified deliveries. Three auditors review each delivery; one proven dispute triggers a spiral penalty: 25% of the bond is seized and burned, a second offense burns 50%, and a third bans the identity for six epochs and revokes its sponsor slot. Forging 1,000 fakes means locking 45,000,000 POA at once, while an honest agent locks just 45,000 POA once. The limit is cold start: honest newcomers with little capital wait longest to earn trust.
